text:
sophia: Quick FYI — I ran the quickstart cURL examples and one of them 400s: the sample using `model_alias` is failing.
omar: which endpoint and file?
sophia: docs/quickstart/api-samples.md -> example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model_alias":"latest-tt", "prompt":"hi"}'` returns 400 -> unknown field `model_alias`.
jen: I think we deprecated `model_alias` in favor of `model` last quarter. That sample must've been missed in the split.
sophia: yep. I'm preparing a tiny PR to update the sample to `"model":"redwood-tt-v2"` and note the migration.
docs-bot: note: doc ownership for `docs/quickstart/api-samples.md` is @jen (CODEOWNERS).
omar: pinging @jen for quick CR on the wording: we should also add a short migration note: "model_alias removed; use model with explicit version".
jen: on it. also spotted: the page's TOC links to `#api-samples` but after the handbook restructure that anchor moved to `#samples-api`. I'll update redirects.yml to cover both anchors to avoid broken links.
sophia: nice catch. there were a couple of external links in the SDK examples that use the old path; I can run linkcheck in staging after your PR.
jen: opening PR now: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/2010 — changes: update cURL snippet, add migration note, add redirects for the old anchor, update a small caption in the sample GIF alt text.
merge-bot: PR 2010 created by jen; CI queued (lint + linkcheck).
docs-bot: small policy reminder: when changing sample payloads, include expected minimal response example to keep tests deterministic. 
sophia: good call. I added a one-liner expected response in the PR description.
omar: requesting quick reviewers: @sophia for sample test and @alex for SDK cross-check. @jen if you want me to pair on redirect formatting I can help.
jen: thanks, @omar — I'll add the REDIRECTS entry in the same PR. aiming to merge after CI green.
merge-bot: CI passed for PR 2010 — linkcheck OK.
jen: merged. deployed to staging.
sophia: smoke-tested the page, the updated cURL works and the redirect from the old anchor lands correctly. all good.
omar: thanks team. small note: let's add a quick line to docs/CHANGELOG.md under "API samples" so teams know the snippet changed.
jen: added changelog entry in the merged PR. closing this thread. :tada:
